hardware: macOS arm64 host; dedicated Colima VZ Linux aarch64 VM with 2 vCPU and 2 GiB RAM; Docker 29.5.2 / API 1.54
internal_review: Codex scientific_review: internal AI-assisted code/protocol/alignment review
Codex privacy_licensing_review: internal AI-assisted code/protocol/alignment review
alignment_rationale: Identical frozen synthetic input bytes and explicit declared GRCh38 are the shared parsing contract. Allelio uses a synthetic-only database with one off-input initialization sentinel and no matching annotations; VEP uses a historical sparse transcript test cache. Keep their real resource fingerprints distinct. No reference-source equivalence, genotype interpretation, allele/source matching or independent approval is asserted.

rights.inputs: Constructed non-personal fixtures, MIT; identifiers are invented syntax labels, not observed genotype/identity assertions.
rights.software: Official VEP software Apache-2.0; retain upstream image archive and LICENSE locally; no code copied from upstream into Allelio.
rights.cache: Official upstream sparse test fixture, retained locally with its source archive/notice. Includes legacy external-source metadata; software licensing does not relicense all cached material.
rights.public: Code, synthetic inputs, reviewed protocol/commands/provenance hashes and parsing counts only; no image/cache or raw VEP annotation payloads.

limitations: Small internal parsing smoke experiment; no independent validation or representative performance estimate.
VEP116.3 is intentionally paired with official upstream sparse test cache84_GRCh38; this is not a current complete human cache.
VCF input echo measures row acceptance/preservation, not identical genotype interpretation or annotation accuracy.
Six shared cases contain seven input records. Five cases are outside the adapter shared scope, not necessarily unsupported by VEP.
Allelio references contain one off-input invented initialization sentinel and no matching annotations; all identity/source/reporting/explanation comparisons remain unsupported.
Resources differ between tools; the pairing declaration binds their distinct identities only for parsing.
No plugins/custom annotations/check_existing/SIFT/PolyPhen are requested. Raw annotation payloads and upstream resources stay local.
Container networking is disabled, cache is read-only, root filesystem is read-only, and no host folders are mounted.
The first attempted case failed on a read-only FASTA lock; this execution is a separately recorded infrastructure correction, not unseen validation.
execution_adjustment: VEP creates FASTA lock/index files. Copy identical pinned test.fa/test.fa.fai bytes from the read-only cache into container tmpfs, then pass --fasta /tmp/test.fa. No source, input or expected outcome is changed.
